briefing: Field Report from Agent Polaris: Multiple investigations and allegations of fraud in Minnesota have surfaced, including a $4M daycare with no kids and misspelled sign. The US Justice Department is investigating Minnesota officials, including Governor Tim Walz and Minneapolis Mayor Jacob Frey, for alleged ICE obstruction. Robert P. Rubicco, a daycare operator, has been charged with fraud and Workers Comp violations. These cases indicate a potential larger pattern of abuse in the childcare industry in Minnesota. Further investigation is needed to determine the extent of the issue and to uncover any connections between entities and programs.
